facts.fact: 在她床上（破裙碎片里）你像死人/痨病者；墙上油画（沉睡青年、铅白皮近绿、眼睑玫瑰影）
facts.anchor: you looked hollowed, like the dead
facts.verbatim: you looked hollowed, like the dead

facts.fact: 「不困扰我躺在这张 Beatrice 爱过尸体的床上」
facts.anchor: lie in the bed where Beatrice Donahue had loved a corpse
facts.verbatim: lie in the bed where Beatrice Donahue had loved a corpse

facts.fact: 她扫视校园寻野猪；泉后她的眠从未胜过打盹——总听见它（尖叫与追逐、鼻拱橡子、心的吼吸）
facts.anchor: the roar and suck of its heart
facts.verbatim: the roar and suck of its heart

facts.fact: 保险柜半开（Celia 数周来很 careless）；枪柄系标签：501.66.1924 Colt 单动左轮，原属 Edward Carver（卒 1883），1924 遗产
枪保养如新、转轮各膛装实弹；她把枪收进口袋（因兽在猎她）
Celia 在背后「我读了那些页」；她跳起接尖叫的水壶；她问她「你打算要什么结局？」
她答：Galatea/Pygmalion——「他爱她不是因为她是她，而是因为他造了她」；「Body 应该淹死那混蛋」
Celia 反驳：Body 也许是 Roland、Ely 是 Beatrice——「Beatrice 能给他们唯一的 happy ending 是一起死、一起腐」
facts.anchor: The only happy ending Beatrice could give them would be to die together. Rot together.
facts.verbatim: The only happy ending Beatrice could give them would be to die together. Rot together.

facts.fact: Joan 判她 always about biography；她心里「很女人味」又恨自己；「这不是辩论」
facts.anchor: It’s always about biography for you.
facts.verbatim: It’s always about biography for you.

facts.fact: 「那些页来自源头。我没写它们」；「它们在洞里，或她在洞里，或她在这儿」
facts.anchor: Those pages … are from the source. I didn’t write them.
facts.verbatim: Those pages … are from the source. I didn’t write them.

facts.fact: Celia 杀人的怒：「是你写的。在药的迷雾里」；「我以为你是学者」
facts.anchor: Don’t be a child about this.
facts.verbatim: Don’t be a child about this.

facts.fact: 撞城锤般的声：兽撞墙、整栋震、獠牙刮楼、绕屋找入口；Celia：「你在见鬼」
她跪着问「你没感觉到吗？」；Celia 冷笑「野猪不会无端这样——你真在失控」；她一秒都不信这否认；指抚裂窗、雪花纹在指下蔓延

facts.verbatim: snowflake fractures spread across the glass
